services.name: Ice Fishing
services.desc: Charter a private floatplane from Squamish, BC and soar over our beautiful coastal mountain peaks. With your own private fishing guide, spend the day angling for untouched, eager rainbow trout in turquoise waters Each angler is outfitted with waders, fins and their own personal belly boat or pontoon boat. Site cast for rising trout or troll for deeper lying fish they are sure to be biting as they are rarely targeted. It will be an incredible day fishing in remote wilderness that you won’t soon forget. The floatplane tour alone is recommended as one of the best things to do in Squamish! So why not add in a little fishing while you gaze at beautiful glaciers and stunning waterfalls. Keep up
